verses.qul-liddawa-iri-inna-l-hubba-munhasirun-: qul lid-dawāʾiri ʾinna l-ḥubba munḥaṣiru biṣiḥḥahi l-ʿaqdi wat-tawḥīdi lil-hadafi
waṣ-ṣaffi wal-ʿamali l-maʿqūli fī ʾadabi lā bit-tamalluqi wat-taṣfīqi was-sarafi
fal-ḥaqqu yaʿlū bitanẓīmi wataṣfiyati mā ʾakhsara l-ḥaqqa malqūṭā maʿa l-khazafi
min wājibi l-fardi fī ʾislāmihi ʿalanā ʾinkāru maṣlaḥahi tadʿū ʾilā ṣ-ṣalafi
mut fī l-ḥayāti taʿish fī d-dīni ḥikmatuhum ʾin kāna lil-mawti maʿnā ṣ-ṣabri fī l-kalafi
hali l-ḥayātu waʾin ghaḍḍat waʾin naʿumat ʾillā kamā qīla bayna ṣ-ṣadri wal-katifi
waghayru dhalika ʾaḥlāmu muzakhrafahu mā qīmatu l-marʾi fī l-ʾaḥlāmi wal-kharafi
yakfīka qawlu bni ʿabdi llāhi min mathali khayrā wakhaylā walā taʿjaz walā takhafi
ʾinna l-biṭālata laysat rāḥata dhukirat hali l-biṭālatu ʾillā mawḍiʿu t-talafi
lawi qtafaytum bimā qad qāla quṭbukumu lamā tafarraqtumu min qawli dhī ṭanafi
ʾinna l-khalīfata fardu fī ʾawāmirihi wafī ʾawāmirihi ramzu mina l-ʾalifi
banā ʿalā ʾususi l-khārāti baʿdu lakum baytā mina l-ʿizzi ʾaw baytā mina sh-sharafi
law taʿlamūna waʾantum fī ḥimāyatihi mā fī ḥimāyatihi min ṣāliḥi s-salafi
fafī riḍāhu riḍāhum dūna masʾalahi wal-ʿaksu bil-ʿaksi maktūbā ʿalā l-khalafi
ʾinna l-ʿaẓīma waʾin jadda l-ḥaqīru lahu maʿa l-ʿaẓīmi ʾamāma l-ḥaqqi wal-ḥanafi
rabbākumu waʿalaykum min khazānatihi mā fī khazānatihi min ʾakrami t-tuḥafi
ʾarā l-khilāfata takhtāru r-rujūʿa ʾilā wādī l-ḥaqāʾiqi wādīhā maʿa l-ʾasafi
tawaḥḥushā billadhī kānat khilāfatuhu faḍlā ʿalā n-nāsi ʾawʾamnā ʿalā l-kalafi
lawlā tashawwufu baʿḍi ṭ-ṭāʾishīna lahā lakānati l-yawma fī ṭayyi maʿa ṣ-ṣuḥufi
man lī bikhayri ʾimāmi fī jamāʿatihi man lī bikhayri murabbi fī l-ʾilahi wafī
man lī bikhayri khaṭībi lā yuḍāmu ʾidhā sāda n-nifāqu waʿamma l-jawru bit-tarafi
man lī bihi wabiʾawṣāfi muṭaharati man lī bikhayri ʾabiyyi baʿdu khayri wafī
ʾinnī bihi wabimā fī nafsihi karamā ʾarjū taḥḥaquqa ʾāmālī bimuʿtakafī
hadhī yadī wayadī hadhī muyassaratu limā lahu khuliqat min khayri muqtaṭafi
hadhā ʾabī waʾabī hadhā faḍāʾiluhu tughnī l-walīda watughnī kulla muʿtarifi
lā khayyaba llāhu fīhā fī taṣarrufihā rajāʾa mustamṭiri bil-ḥubbi muttaṣifi
